name: Solar Industries India Ltd
title: Solar Industries India Ltd - 532725 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record Q4 FY26 revenue INR3,053 cr and EBITDA margin ~28.5% led by defence (INR1,008 cr, +134%); FY27 guide INR14,000 cr revenue at current margins, with working capital days rising to build inventory.

utilisation.quote: our capacity utilization level has gone up

capex.quote: entering into FY '27 with a planned annual capex of INR2,050 crores

triggers.label: FY27 revenue target INR14,000 cr
triggers.quote: we are targeting to achieve a revenue of INR14,000 crores in FY '27, while maintaining current margins

triggers.label: Defence order book ~INR18,000 cr
triggers.quote: defense is around INR18,000 crores, and nondefense is around INR3,000 crores

triggers.label: FY27 growth ~18-20% from price
triggers.quote: around 20% -- 18% to 20% should come from the price rise

guidance.quote: we are targeting to achieve a revenue of INR14,000 crores in FY '27, while maintaining current margins
we should be able to maintain the current EBITDA margins
we should cross defense revenue of INR4,500 crores in FY '27
next year also, we are expecting a growth of a round 30%
planned annual capex of INR2,050 crores

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have delivered 30% revenue growth and surpassed our annual EBITDA guidance

red_flags.label: Subsidiary profit contribution muted until Q3
red_flags.quote: in the first 6 months, the results from the defense section as well as the international as far as margins are concerned were subdued

red_flags.label: Possible demand contraction on high AN prices
red_flags.quote: there can be a demand contraction for some couple of months

evasions.quote: As of now, we don't have that kind of visibility.
But still, such kind of product development takes longer time than what we expect.
I would not like to comment on the competition side or competitive
